fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong Archetype detail pages did not display the `description` field even though it was already fetched from the database by `load_archetypes()` and accessible via `__getattr__` on the `Archetype` view class. ## What changed Added a conditional Mustache block to `decksite/templates/archetype.mustache` that renders the description in a `

` element before the Decks section. The `{{#description}}...{{/description}}` guard means the element only renders when a non-empty description exists, so archetypes with admin-facing or empty descriptions are unaffected until descriptions are updated editorially. ## Validation - `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed - `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (full suite with live MariaDB) Fixes #8070
fix.pr_title: Show archetype description on archetype detail pages (#8070)
